notes.title: Hard Glide Update 1.5.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] added mouse aim for "mouse + WASD" control scheme
[*] fixed periodically occurring error of not being able to press "continue" with gamepad
[*] fixed error with disappearing shadows from small objects when camera is at maximum distance
[/list]

notes.title: Hard Glide Update 1.5.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] animation of stick tilt for gamepad hints
[*] adjustment of some gameplay parameters for different control schemes
[*] decreased movement speed of the enemy "Constructor" (a.k.a. Electro psycho)
[*] safe zones for the boss "Igniter" have been slightly expanded
[/list]

notes.title: Hard Glide Update 1.5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] added new control schemes - gamepad and mouse+WASD
[*] fixed bug with displaying progress
[*] fixed bug with incorrect calculation of acceleration/deceleration of movement at low FPS
[*] fixed other minor flaws and bugs at game levels
[/list]

notes.title: A small request
notes.notes: Little brave bot! I have a request for you. If you have purchased the game Hard Glide, please consider leaving a review on Steam. Your feedback is very important for the game to reach 10 reviews, which will allow it to start displaying a rating. Thank you!

notes.title: Hard Glide update 1.4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] added a new ending "Extraction"!
[*] fixed a fatal error in the ending "awakening", also fixed a bug with fog in the endings.
[*] added another dynamic hint about aiming in the game.
[*] fixed a bug with incorrect display of subtitles in some languages.
[*] Improved video animation performance.
[*] when losing focus, the game is paused, you can also unpause it using ESC
[*] added an achievement "extraction" - finish the game with the ending "extraction"
[*] the achievement "sniper" has been changed, to achieve it, it is enough to make 15 consecutive accurate shots.
[*] fixed a bug with the "shield" bonus and electric shock
[*] fixed minor flaws in the game levels
[/list]

notes.title: Hard Glide Update 1.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] now enemies do not react (do not see) the player who is behind a stationary obstacle
[*] some transit levels are simplified, also all rotating elements on them are visible at once
[*] fixed a bug with the pause menu when completing transit levels
[*] added a setting that allows you to disable zooming in/out of the camera, fixing it in the desired position
[*] added a setting that allows you to change/disable camera shaking
[*] fixed a bug with the disappearance of diode laser barriers, also fixed collisions with laser barriers
[*] relic from the "Bridge" level moved to the main set of levels of the "Darklands" arena
[*] after completing the arena, information about the found or not found relic is now shown
[*] the "Free Will" ending has been renamed to "Liberation"
[*] fixed several minor errors on the levels
[/list]

notes.title: Hard Glide Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] fixed bug with crazy camera shaking at low fps
[*] fixed bug with closed gates when re-visiting the bridge
[*] difficulty of some levels reduced
[*] fixed some interface bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Hard Glide Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[list]

[*] time limit for the bridge level raised to 260 minutes
[*] some levels balanced in difficulty
[*] some bugs fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Hard Glide Demo is available!
notes.notes:
Hey, I am glad to present you a new demo of my game! 
Hard Glide is an experimental arcade game with inertial control using only a mouse. A small fragile bot awakens in the bizarre world of machines and, guided by the voice of the Mainframe, overcomes increasingly difficult levels filled with various hostile bots and obstacles to achieve his main Goal. That's what his Program says. Bonuses and various modifiers are included!
